save_paddle_tensors_to_bytes: save a dictionary of paddle tensors to raw bytes in safetensors format
save_paddle_tensors_to_file: save a dictionary of paddle tensors to a safetensors file on disk
load_paddle_tensors_from_bytes: load paddle tensors from raw bytes in safetensors format
load_paddle_tensors_from_file: load paddle tensors from a safetensors file on disk
flatten_paddle_tensors: flatten a dictionary of paddle tensors into TensorSpec dictionaries for serialization
